data.narrative:
Windborne is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $23.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 peers in the Climate & Energy sector—1 public (Lenz Energy, ticker LNZA) and 8 private companies including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, no same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with sufficient similarity exist in sufficient quantity to support a reliable peer-median approach; the Climate & Energy sector lacks three or more comparables meeting narrow stage and valuation-tier filters.

Consequently, the valuation relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier—typical for Series A to next-stage advancement—to the $23.4M total raised as a proxy for post-seed valuation. This produces an implied valuation of $47M. A 15% band around this point estimate yields a range of $40M (low) to $54M (high), reflecting ordinary step-up variance.

The analysis supports a median valuation of $47M, with a defensible range of $40M–$54M. Key uncertainties include (1) absence of tight-fit peer comparables in the Climate & Energy space at this stage, making stage-based extrapolation the sole quantitative anchor, and (2) lack of forward-looking financial metrics or technology milestones that would refine the multiplier. Additional data on similar-stage climate-tech raises or Windborne's specific technology risk profile would strengthen conviction.
